rules.release_gate: both flux scales AND both truth PSFs AND both spectra: paired RMSE lower, no extra failed/boundary fits; no post-hoc model selection

params.QUERY: SELECT source_name,ra,dec,ra_pm,dec_pm,sigra_pm,sigdec_pm,pmra,pmdec,sigpmra,sigpmdec,meanobsmjd,w1mpro_pm,w2mpro_pm,w2snr_pm,w2rchi2_pm,cc_flags,ab_flags FROM catwise_2020 WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',133.76037473328523,-7.242149767967145,0.30))=1 AND w2mpro_pm<17.0 AND w2snr_pm>=5 ORDER BY source_name
SELECT source_name,source_id FROM catwise_2020 WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',133.76037473328523,-7.242149767967145,0.30))=1 AND w2mpro_pm<17.0 AND w2snr_pm>=5

SELECT a.uri,p.time_bounds_lower,p.energy_bandpassname,p.provenance_version FROM spherex.artifact a JOIN spherex.plane p ON a.planeid=p.planeid WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',133.76037473328523,-7.242149767967145),p.poly)=1 AND a.uri LIKE '%/qr3/%'
